description: One mission waiting in a product's bank, at @worktrees/banked/<product>/<missionId>/mission.json beside the mission.md a person reads. It carries the whole goal block a session needs — `goalDraft` is copied into state.json.mission unchanged, so its shape is that of templates/step/state.schema.json#mission — the routes and environment the mission runs against, and at least one evidence ref. The evidence ref is what makes a banked mission a proposal about this product rather than an idea: it names the unchecked entry, the finding, the walk or e2e run, the source file or the person's note the mission was drafted from, and a mission with none is refused (BANK_UNGROUNDED). What has become of the mission — its order, its status, what it waits for, how urgent it is — lives in queue.json and not here, so the bank has one home for its order and one for its content.

title.description: the one line the person picks the mission by, in the display language

why.description: what the evidence refs showed, in the helper's own words; the mission.md repeats it and states it nowhere else

routes.description: the roles of the product this mission binds (the route ids of @workspaces/<project>/<role>); a chain is planned at open time and pins nothing here

env.description: the environment whose declaration authorises what the mission touches

acceptance.description: what the person will read the delivery against, beyond the done-when lines; it is a reading aid and never a done-when line in disguise, because only a done-when line names a producing operator

tierHint.description: what the unchecked ledger suggested this mission's coverage is: a mission drafted from an open journey entry is hinted journey, one drafted from a secondary entry is hinted secondary. It is a hint the plan reads and overrides; the tier itself is decided by the plan against the confirmed done-when journey (templates/kinds/units.schema.json)

goalDraft.description: the goal block, in the shape state.json.mission takes it: the session copies it, prints it and — under a current bank approval — does not wait for an answer

evidenceRef.description: one observation the mission was drafted from, as <scheme>:<ref>. The schemes are closed and each names a reader the tree already has: `unchecked` an entry id of @worktrees/unchecked, `finding` an id of knowledge/findings, `uat` and `e2e` a run under @worktrees/uat or @worktrees/e2e, `source` a path in a bound checkout, `fe` and `be` the same in the named role's route, `note` a reference to something the person wrote.
